- Have people download different read datasets of the same organism:
    - Short reads vs long reads
    - Different levels of coverage (10x, 20x, 50x, 100x)
- Assemble genome using appropriate tool (`xyz` for short reads, `flye` for long reads)
- Register assembly metrics in google sheet
- Visualize results! Each student pair gets to analyze a different assembly metric. Perhaps present results?
